```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


shared = [
    [2, 41],
    [2, 41.2],
    [2, 41.4],
    [2, 41.6],
    [2, 41.8],
    [2, 42],
]
outer_a = [[2, 42], [1, 42], [1, 41], [2, 41]]
outer_b = [[2, 41], [3, 41], [3, 42], [2, 42]]

geojson = {
    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "features": [
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "properties": {"nom": "A"},
            "geometry": {
                "type": "Polygon",
                "coordinates": [[*shared, *outer_a[1:]]],
            },
        },
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "properties": {"nom": "B"},
            "geometry": {
                "type": "Polygon",
                "coordinates": [[*outer_b, *list(reversed(shared))[1:]]],
            },
        },
    ],
}

topojson = {
    "type": "Topology",
    "objects": {
        "municipis": {
            "type": "GeometryCollection",
            "geometries": [
                {
                    "type": "Polygon",
                    "arcs": [[1, 0]],
                    "properties": {"nom": "A"},
                },
                {
                    "type": "Polygon",
                    "arcs": [[2, -2]],
                    "properties": {"nom": "B"},
                },
            ],
        }
    },
    "arcs": [outer_a, shared, outer_b],
}


def minified_size(value):
    serialized = json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    )
    return len(serialized.encode("utf-8"))


geojson_bytes = minified_size(geojson)
topojson_bytes = minified_size(topojson)
geojson_positions = sum(
    len(ring)
    for feature in geojson["features"]
    for ring in feature["geometry"]["coordinates"]
)
topojson_positions = sum(len(arc) for arc in topojson["arcs"])
byte_saving = 100 * (geojson_bytes - topojson_bytes) / geojson_bytes
position_saving = 100 * (geojson_positions - topojson_positions) / geojson_positions
byte_saving_label = str(f"{byte_saving:.1f}").replace(".", ",")
position_saving_label = str(f"{position_saving:.1f}").replace(".", ",")

assert (geojson_bytes, topojson_bytes) == (367, 328)
assert (geojson_positions, topojson_positions) == (18, 14)

width, height = 1600, 780
shared_y = [510, 438, 366, 294, 222, 150]

svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Frontera repetida en GeoJSON i arc compartit en TopoJSON</title>',
    f'  <desc id="desc">Dos polígons adjacents repeteixen sis posicions de la frontera en GeoJSON. TopoJSON desa la frontera una vegada com a arc i cada polígon la recorre en un sentit. En aquest exemple, les posicions baixen de {geojson_positions} a {topojson_positions} i el JSON minificat sense compressió baixa de {geojson_bytes} a {topojson_bytes} bytes, un {byte_saving_label} per cent.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    '      .panel-letter { fill: #21313c; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .panel-title { fill: #21313c; font-size: 31px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .region { fill: #21313c; font-size: 38px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .label { fill: #435861; font-size: 30px; }',
    '      .metric { fill: #21313c; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .bar-metric { fill: #ffffff; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .saving { fill: #397253; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .note { fill: #5f7079; font-size: 29px; }',
    '      .area-a { fill: #dceef4; stroke: #276d88; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .area-b { fill: #f6e7dc; stroke: #a85532; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .copy-a { fill: none; stroke: #276d88; stroke-width: 7; }',
    '      .copy-b { fill: none; stroke: #a85532; stroke-width: 7; }',
    '      .shared { fill: none; stroke: #397253; stroke-width: 9; }',
    '      .point-a { fill: #276d88; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .point-b { fill: #a85532; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .point-shared { fill: #397253; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .divider { stroke: #d2dadd; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .bar-geo { fill: #276d88; }',
    '      .bar-topo { fill: #397253; }',
    '      .guide { stroke: #aebbc1; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '    </style>',
    '  </defs>',
    f'  <rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="#ffffff"/>',
    '  <line x1="545" y1="35" x2="545" y2="735" class="divider"/>',
    '  <line x1="1090" y1="35" x2="1090" y2="735" class="divider"/>',

    # GeoJSON stores one closed coordinate ring per feature.
    '  <text x="55" y="70" class="panel-letter">a</text>',
    '  <text x="95" y="70" class="panel-title">GeoJSON: dues geometries</text>',
    '  <rect x="95" y="150" width="205" height="360" class="area-a"/>',
    '  <rect x="300" y="150" width="205" height="360" class="area-b"/>',
    '  <text x="195" y="350" text-anchor="middle" class="region">A</text>',
    '  <text x="405" y="350" text-anchor="middle" class="region">B</text>',
    '  <line x1="294" y1="150" x2="294" y2="510" class="copy-a"/>',
    '  <line x1="306" y1="150" x2="306" y2="510" class="copy-b"/>',
]

for y in shared_y:
    svg.extend([
        f'  <circle cx="294" cy="{y}" r="7" class="point-a"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="306" cy="{y}" r="7" class="point-b"/>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="300" y="565" text-anchor="middle" class="label">la mateixa frontera × 2</text>',
    f'  <text x="300" y="615" text-anchor="middle" class="metric">{geojson_positions} posicions</text>',
    '  <text x="300" y="653" text-anchor="middle" class="note">un anell complet per polígon</text>',

    # TopoJSON stores the common boundary once and references its orientation.
    '  <text x="600" y="70" class="panel-letter">b</text>',
    '  <text x="640" y="70" class="panel-title">TopoJSON: tres arcs</text>',
    '  <rect x="640" y="150" width="205" height="360" class="area-a"/>',
    '  <rect x="845" y="150" width="205" height="360" class="area-b"/>',
    '  <text x="740" y="350" text-anchor="middle" class="region">A</text>',
    '  <text x="950" y="350" text-anchor="middle" class="region">B</text>',
    '  <line x1="845" y1="150" x2="845" y2="510" class="shared"/>',
])

for y in shared_y:
    svg.append(f'  <circle cx="845" cy="{y}" r="8" class="point-shared"/>')

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="745" y="565" text-anchor="middle" class="label">A → arc 1 ↑</text>',
    '  <text x="945" y="565" text-anchor="middle" class="label">B → arc −2 ↓</text>',
    f'  <text x="845" y="615" text-anchor="middle" class="metric">{topojson_positions} posicions</text>',
    '  <text x="845" y="653" text-anchor="middle" class="note">una sola còpia de la frontera</text>',

    # Byte counts come from the same complete objects printed in the chapter.
    '  <text x="1145" y="70" class="panel-letter">c</text>',
    '  <text x="1185" y="70" class="panel-title">Mida serialitzada</text>',
    '  <line x1="1180" y1="475" x2="1535" y2="475" class="guide"/>',
    '  <text x="1180" y="175" class="label">GeoJSON</text>',
    '  <rect x="1180" y="195" width="320" height="82" class="bar-geo"/>',
    f'  <text x="1490" y="247" text-anchor="end" class="bar-metric">{geojson_bytes} bytes</text>',
    '  <text x="1180" y="335" class="label">TopoJSON</text>',
    f'  <rect x="1180" y="355" width="{320 * topojson_bytes / geojson_bytes:.1f}" height="82" class="bar-topo"/>',
    f'  <text x="{1170 + 320 * topojson_bytes / geojson_bytes:.1f}" y="407" text-anchor="end" class="bar-metric">{topojson_bytes} bytes</text>',
    f'  <text x="1350" y="540" text-anchor="middle" class="saving">−{geojson_bytes - topojson_bytes} bytes · −{byte_saving_label}%</text>',
    f'  <text x="1350" y="595" text-anchor="middle" class="metric">{geojson_positions} → {topojson_positions} posicions</text>',
    f'  <text x="1350" y="633" text-anchor="middle" class="note">−{position_saving_label}% de posicions</text>',
    '  <text x="1350" y="682" text-anchor="middle" class="note">JSON minificat · UTF-8</text>',
    '  <text x="1350" y="720" text-anchor="middle" class="note">sense compressió</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/geojson-topojson-shared-border.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
